connection_condition: a school's CDS code carries its district segment in characters 3-7, which corresponds to the district record whose school segment is '0000000'
description: A school district is composed of the schools it operates; a school record has no meaning without the district that administers it.

connection_condition: the first two characters of the CDS code hold the county code, and every district label appears under exactly one county label
description: A county contains the school districts located within it; the county is the enclosing geographic unit.

connection_condition: schools.CDSCode, frpm.CDSCode and satscores.cds all carry the CDS code, though the satscores copy sometimes lacks the leading zero
description: The CDS code is the canonical identifier of a school and encodes its county, district and school segments; it is the field through which the three tables are aligned.

connection_condition: schools.Charter carries the school-level flag and frpm.'Charter School (Y/N)' repeats it
description: Charter status classifies a school as charter or non-charter.

connection_condition: schools.Virtual carries the status code for each school record
description: Virtual instruction status classifies how a school delivers instruction, from fully classroom-based to exclusively virtual.

connection_condition: schools.DOC is constant down to the district segment of the CDS code and is mirrored by frpm.'District Type'
description: The district ownership code states the administrative type of a district, such as Unified or Elementary school district.

connection_condition: schools.SOC holds the code and schools.SOCType holds its label
description: The school ownership code states the level and ownership category of a school, such as High Schools (Public).

connection_condition: schools.StatusType holds the status of each school record
description: Status type states whether a school record describes an active, closed, merged or pending school.

connection_condition: the rate column equals the free meal count divided by K-12 enrollment for every populated row
description: The eligible free meal rate is derived from the free meal count over the K-12 enrollment denominator.

connection_condition: the rate column equals the FRPM count divided by K-12 enrollment for every populated row
description: The eligible FRPM rate is derived from the free or reduced price meal count over the K-12 enrollment denominator.

connection_condition: FRPM Count (K-12) is greater than or equal to Free Meal Count (K-12) in every populated row, the difference being the reduced-price meal count
description: The free or reduced price meal count is composed of the free meal count and the reduced price meal count.

connection_condition: schools.Street and schools.MailStreet hold the same kind of street label; they coincide for most schools but are separate columns
description: The postal street address and the mailing street address are treated as synonymous expressions of a school's street address, so a request for one should also surface the other.

connection_condition: both counts live side by side in each frpm row, and K-12 enrollment is never smaller than the ages 5-17 count
description: K-12 enrollment and ages 5-17 enrollment are two overlapping measures of the same student population, differing by grade-based versus age-based scope.

connection_condition: satscores rows with rtype = 'S' carry the CDS code of the school they describe
description: The average SAT reading score is a school-level performance measure reported for individual schools.

connection_condition: satscores rows with rtype = 'S' carry the CDS code of the school they describe
description: The average SAT math score is a school-level performance measure reported for individual schools.

connection_condition: satscores rows with rtype = 'S' carry the CDS code of the school they describe
description: The average SAT writing score is a school-level performance measure reported for individual schools.

connection_condition: the '(K-12)' suffix on the frpm measures and the Low Grade / High Grade columns both express the same grade scope
description: The K-12 grade range is the scope over which the K-12 enrollment and K-12 meal counts are measured.

connection_condition: both dates sit on the same school record and together delimit its operating period
description: Open date and closed date together describe the period during which a school operated; a null closed date marks a school that has not closed.

connection_condition: schools.FundingType carries the label per school and frpm.'Charter Funding Type' repeats it for charter schools
description: Funding type states the funding arrangement under which a school operates, such as directly funded or locally funded.

connection_condition: schools.GSoffered and schools.GSserved carry the grade range on each school record
description: The grade span states which grades a school offers and serves, and therefore which student population its enrollment counts cover.
